author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
AI will be as good as most humans for 80% of tasks in a year or two. 

If the customers of your job is OK with 80% quality at 20% of the cost, you are basically screwed. 

If your job needs 100% quality, either it works or it doesn't, like an 80% completed bridge is no bridge, then AI is your best friend.
